title: DARE: Diverse Visual Question Answering with Robustness Evaluation
findings: State-of-the-art VLMs like Gemini and GPT-4 achieve near-human performance on single-correct questions about cultural and religious concepts. However, their performance is substantially lower in more complex multi-correct scenarios and they show a lack of robustness when tested with variations in answer options and output formats.
references: Josh Achiam, Steven Adler, Sandhini Agarwal, Lama Ahmad, Ilge Akkaya, Florencia Leoni Aleman, Diogo Almeida, Janko Altenschmidt, Sam Altman, Shyamal Anadkat, et al. 2023. Gpt-4 technical report. arXiv preprint arXiv:2303.08774.
